lines.choice: Adafruit INA228 I2C 85V 20-bit high/low side power monitor, STEMMA QT (product 5832)
lines.notes: Chosen over a generic INA226: no authorised INA226 breakout found (Adafruit does not list one), and common INA226 modules use an R100 shunt that only reads ~0.8 A. The INA228 has an onboard 15 mohm shunt good to 10 A and 85 V. For the full actuator rail (>10 A) use either part with an external shunt.

lines.item: Relay >=30 A for actuator rail, switched by e-stop
lines.choice: TEMCo 24V 40A 4-pin Bosch-style automotive relay, SPST (SKU CN0345)
lines.notes: Sale price $8.73 (standard $9.70), free shipping. Coil current not published: TBD, measure coil resistance. Comparable TE V23134 24 V 40 A relays list ~268-332 ohm / 1.6 W coils (RS/Distrelec), i.e. ~55-70 mA at 18 V. Main open question: a 24 V coil on a 15-21 V pack is below its rating; the must-operate voltage was not found for any 24 V part (TBD from the datasheet). A 12 V coil is overdriven at 21 V (1.75x rating) and would need a series resistor or a 12 V regulator. Bench-test pull-in at 15 V before committing, or use a 12 V coil relay fed from a 12 V buck.

lines.item: Serial bus servo 12 V 30 kg.cm (wrist/forearm/hand joints)
lines.choice: Feetech ST3215-C047 12V 30 kg.cm, 1:345 (Seeed SKU 108090003); equivalent STS3215-C018 12V 1/345
lines.notes: VARIANT FINDING: both C018 and C047 are the 12 V / 30 kg.cm / 1:345 STS3215 (C018 = SO-ARM100/101 follower servo per OpenELAB/rcdrone; C047 = the code Seeed sells for the SO-101 12 V kit). C001 = 7.4 V 1/345, C044 = 7.4 V 1/191, C046 = 7.4 V 1/147 (SO-101 leader). No official Feetech page found distinguishing C018 vs C047; treat as interchangeable 12 V 1:345 parts and confirm on order. Seeed price 22.00 each (20.90 at 10+). Mass not given on pages read. Waveshare-branded ST3215 12V (SKU 22414) also available at 16.99-21.99 range (per-variant price not shown).

lines.choice: Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter (A), SKU 25514
lines.notes: Recommend 2 (one per arm): 7 servos per bus halves sync-read/write cycle time at 1 Mbps, keeps each arm's bus cable short (no 1 m+ TTL run across the torso), isolates faults (one arm's bus short or ID clash does not kill the other), and pairs with one 12 V buck per arm. Board current rating is NOT stated: per-arm worst-case stall is ~23.4 A (3 x 4.2 A + 4 x 2.7 A), so feed servo power from a separate 12 V distribution and use the adapter for data (or verify its power path). Feetech FE-URT-1 not priced (one source per item).

lines.choice: EKYLIN 24V to 12V 20A 240W step-down converter, DC 15-40V input (Amazon ASIN B01JAIC9EM)
lines.notes: Buy-box price hidden ('add to cart to see'); 17.47 is the 'New & Used (4) from' price on the Amazon page, so may be a third-party/used offer. Qty 2 = one per arm: worst-case total stall 46.8 A (6 x 4.2 + 8 x 2.7) exceeds one 20 A unit; per arm 23.4 A worst case, normal running far lower. Dropout at 15 V input (end of M18 discharge) TBD: check output stays at 12 V. lines.item: Ideal-diode OR of two battery inputs
lines.choice: GODIYMODULES / DIY-Module 40A-60A ideal diode module, single channel (Amazon ASIN B0DDBYNDX5), one per input into a common bus

Controller IC and minimum operating voltage unknown: verify it fully enhances at 15 V and blocks reverse current when one pack is removed. 40 V reverse limit is fine for 18-21 V and 24 V inputs.

lines.item: Relay >=30 A for actuator rail, switched by e-stop
lines.choice: TEMCo 24V 40A 4-pin Bosch-style automotive relay, SPST (SKU CN0345)
lines.notes: Sale price $8.73 (standard $9.70), free shipping. Coil current not published: TBD, measure coil resistance. Comparable TE V23134 24 V 40 A relays list ~268-332 ohm / 1.6 W coils (RS/Distrelec), i.e. ~55-70 mA at 18 V. Main open question: a 24 V coil on a 15-21 V pack is below its rating; the must-operate voltage was not found for any 24 V part (TBD from the datasheet). A 12 V coil is overdriven at 21 V (1.75x rating) and would need a series resistor or a 12 V regulator. Bench-test pull-in at 15 V before committing, or use a 12 V coil relay fed from a 12 V buck.

lines.choice: Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter (A), SKU 25514

Board current rating is NOT stated: per-arm worst-case stall is ~23.4 A (3 x 4.2 A + 4 x 2.7 A), so feed servo power from a separate 12 V distribution and use the adapter for data (or verify its power path).
